meta.name: interview-script
meta.description: Create a structured customer interview script with JTBD probing questions, warm-up, core exploration, and wrap-up sections. Follows The Mom Test principles — no leading questions, no pitching, focus on past behavior. Use when preparing for user interviews, creating interview guides, or planning discovery research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成结构化客户访谈脚本，遵循JTBD和The Mom Test原则
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要准备用户访谈或发现研究，避免引导性问题
copy.tagline_en: Create structured customer interview scripts following JTBD and The Mom Test principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to prepare user interviews or discovery research without leading questions

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会根据你提供的研究目标，生成一份结构化的客户访谈脚本，包含开场、热身、核心探索（JTBD）、追问技巧和收尾，并附上笔记模板。脚本遵循《The Mom Test》原则，避免引导性问题。
howto.when: 当你准备进行用户访谈、创建访谈指南或规划发现研究时，可以要求 Claude 生成脚本。

say.text: 帮我生成一份用户访谈脚本，主题是了解用户如何管理日常任务。
say.note: Claude 会输出包含所有章节的完整脚本。

say.text: 我需要一份针对 SaaS 产品用户的 JTBD 访谈脚本。
say.note: Claude 会定制问题，聚焦于用户要完成的任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude generates a structured customer interview script with opening, warm-up, core exploration (JTBD), probing techniques, and wrap-up, plus a note-taking template. It follows The Mom Test principles — no leading questions, no pitching.
howto.when_en: Trigger when you are preparing for user interviews, creating interview guides, or planning discovery research.

say_en.text: Generate a user interview script about how people manage daily tasks.
say_en.note: Claude outputs a full script with all sections.

say_en.text: I need a JTBD interview script for SaaS product users.
say_en.note: Claude customizes questions to focus on jobs to be done.
